summary: This informational RFC updates RFC 7315 by changing the extension-access-info part of the SIP P-Access-Network-Info header ABNF, and adding two access-info parameter values, operator-specific-GI and utran-sai-3gpp, that were defined but missing from the list.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC updates the grammar for a SIP header. It adds two missing access-info values and uses a less restrictive rule for extensions.

questions: what does rfc 7913 change in rfc 7315
subtitle: Updates the ABNF for the SIP P-Access-Network-Info header field.

tldr.problem: The P-Access-Network-Info ABNF used a more restrictive rule for extensions and omitted two values already defined in the grammar.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC changes extension-access-info from gen-value to generic-param and adds operator-specific-GI and utran-sai-3gpp to access-info.
tldr.outcome: The RFC says the update is not expected to cause backward-compatibility issues and does not affect security considerations.

today: RFC 7913 is an Informational document that updates RFC 7315. The unit metadata does not list it as obsoleted or updated.

sections.title: The P-Access-Network-Info Grammar
sections.content:
RFC 7315 defines the SIP P-Access-Network-Info header field. Its access-info parameter has predefined values, and most follow the generic-param rule from RFC 3261.

However, RFC 7315's ABNF required new values to follow the more restrictive gen-value rule, even though new values had already been defined using generic-param. It also defined operator-specific-GI and utran-sai-3gpp without including them in the access-info list.
sections.plainLanguage: The grammar required a stricter form for new values than other values used. It also left two already-defined values off the list.

sections.title: The ABNF Update
sections.content:
RFC 7913 updates Section 5.4 of RFC 7315. It adds operator-specific-GI and utran-sai-3gpp to the access-info alternatives.

It also changes the definition of extension-access-info from gen-value to generic-param. The update aligns the grammar with values that had already been defined using generic-param.
sections.plainLanguage: The revised list includes two more values. The extension rule now uses generic-param.

sections.title: Compatibility and Security
sections.content:
The RFC notes that P-Access-Network-Info is mainly used in networks defined by 3GPP, where new generic-param values have already been defined. It therefore does not consider the change likely to cause backward-compatibility issues.

The security considerations remain those in RFC 7315. RFC 7913 says its ABNF update does not affect them.
sections.plainLanguage: The RFC expects the change to fit existing 3GPP use. It says the update does not change the security considerations.
